authorization: User authorized trying a pilot before extending remaining conditions.

references.lambda_0p1: Existing completed P0 runs at matched regime/seed/lead7
references.baseline: Existing completed baseline runs; does not equal auxiliary-only lambda0

protected: Original src, existing train_data_efficiency.py, subsets, time splits, val/test indices and all prior Full/subset outputs preserved.
rng: New arms preserve legacy P0 initialization and loader RNG exactly; CPU parity check isolates extra-head RNG consumption with identical fixed batches.
primary_outcome: Paired test RMSE differences, especially new lambdas versus aux-only lambda0 and old P0 lambda0.1; every arm and seed reported.
selection: One lambda among 0,0.01,0.1,0.3 per regime minimizing mean best validation RMSE across all 3 seeds; exact ties use smaller lambda. Physics lambda0 retains auxiliary loss.

uncertainty.exact_paired_sign_flip: 3 pairs, minimum two-sided p=0.25; no p<0.05 claim across training seeds

time_bootstrap.scope: Conditional on fitted models; unadjusted exploratory intervals, not new-seed inference

noninferiority: No claim of equivalence or no harm from a nonsignificant result; no prespecified application-based margin available.
expansion: Pilot stops after all 18 runs plus evaluation and report. Broader experiment needs review of integrity, effect size and mixed/negative outcomes; no automatic favorable-test filtering.
